title: Announcing Strategic Backing From Y Combinator and LeapYear
summary: o11, the OpenRouter for agentic commerce, has strategic backing from Y Combinator (Winter 2026) and LeapYear. Here is what we build and what comes next.
body_markdown:
o11 has strategic backing from[Y Combinator](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/o11) and[LeapYear](https://takeleapyear.com/) . We are part of Y Combinator’s Winter 2026 batch, and LeapYear backs a small group of builders each year who take a year to build something ambitious.


o11 is the OpenRouter for agentic commerce: one wallet, API and MCP server that lets AI agents find, use and pay per call for paid APIs and services.


## At a glance


- **Company:**[o11](https://o11.ai/) , founded in 2025 in San Francisco
- **Founders:**[Aryah Oztanir](https://oztanir.com/) and[Ajay Misra](https://ajaymisra.com/)
- **Backed by:**[Y Combinator](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/o11) , Winter 2026, and[LeapYear](https://takeleapyear.com/)
- **What we build:** A wallet your agents use to pay for the tools they need, and[Kits](https://o11.ai/kits) , skills and workflows your agents follow


## What o11 does


Agents are good at deciding which tool a task needs. Paying for it is where they stop: every provider wants its own account, plan, card and API key. o11 replaces that with one wallet.


- **One wallet, thousands of tools.** Your agent finds a tool in the[o11 catalog](https://go.o11.ai/catalog) , sees the price first and pays per call. No subscriptions or vendor onboarding.
- **Limits you set.** Each agent key gets a spending limit and the tools it may use. Every call is recorded, and you can revoke a key at any time.
- **Your own accounts, too.** Connect the accounts you already pay for, and your agent uses them without seeing the credentials.
- **Kits for the work itself.**[Kits](https://o11.ai/kits) are skills and workflows your agents follow, made by o11 and the teams who do the work.[Ostack](https://o11.ai/ostack) is o11’s own set, for outbound, launch videos, SEO and social.


Teams already run real work on it.[Khotan](https://o11.ai/blog/khotan-ai-agent-lead-research) , a fellow Y Combinator company, gets lead data from ten providers through one o11 card, paying only for the lookups its agent runs.


## Why Y Combinator and LeapYear


Y Combinator puts us next to founders who build with agents every day, and many of them are the teams we build for. You can find o11 in[YC’s company directory](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/o11) .


[LeapYear](https://takeleapyear.com/) is a fund for students, dropouts and graduates who take a year to build something ambitious. That is how we approach o11: build fast, ship to real teams and keep what they use.


## What's next


Next, we keep building what teams ask for: more tools in the catalog, kits for more kinds of work and faster setup for every agent.


- **Try o11:** copy the setup prompt on[o11.ai](https://o11.ai/) and paste it into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor.
- **Browse kits:** see every kit at[o11.ai/kits](https://o11.ai/kits) , or[publish your own](https://go.o11.ai/sellers/kits) .
- **Talk to us:**[book a demo](https://o11.ai/demo) to set up o11 for your team.
